name: com.mayamate/claimtrace
title: ClaimTrace
description: Check every number in an AI-written document against its source, with the source span.

tools.name: check_numbers
tools.description: Check every number in an AI-written document against its sources. Each source is a URL (http:// or https://) or pasted source text; at most 3. Returns a one-line summary and the claim ledger: each numeric claim labelled SUPPORTED, MISMATCH or UNSUPPORTED with the source span. Set share=true for a public report link (kept 30 days).

document.title: Document
document.description: The text whose numbers you want checked (an AI-written draft, memo, investor update, article). Plain text or markdown. Every numeric claim in it is extracted and checked.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: 1 to 3 sources the numbers should come from. Each item is either a public http(s) URL (HTML or PDF, fetched by the server) or the source text pasted directly.

share.title: Share
share.description: If true, also publish the claim ledger as a public report page and return its link (kept 30 days). Default false: nothing is stored.
